The contractor shall bear all expenses, including vehicle, driver, cleaner, fuel, oil, lubricants, accessories, major and minor re pairs, permits, maintenance, taxes, and other associated costs. The vehicle shall be subject to inspectio n by the consignee. ADSTE/TELE/BY shall maintain and sign logbook. 2. The hired vehicle shall be parked at the residence or office of ADSTE/TELE/BY, or at any other locatio n as directed by the consignee officer. 3. Firms or contractors reported as adverse, blacklisted, or having poor 77performance in the last two years shall not be eligible to participate in this tender. Bidders shall submit a declaration confirming co mpliance with this clause. 4. The vehicle shall be operated as per the consent and convenience of the consignee officer. 5. The vehicle hiring shall strictly adhere to the new vehicle hiring policy related to minimum wages o f driver as per issued by Central Railways GM Office vide letter no. G.452/Hiring/Policy 2024 dated Janua ry 11,2024. Document at tached in clause 10. Buyer Added Bid specific ATC . Bidders must submit a dec laration can firming compliance with this clause. 6. The vehicle is designated for outstation use and may be required to operate from any location to an y other within the jurisdiction of Central Railways. 7. The officer's vehicle will be stationed at Badhwar park railway colony/CSMT; therefore, drivers mus t reside in close proximity. The ten derer should submit the authorization certificate from the owner for the use of vehic le against this tender/work. The vehicle should have all types of permits required by the Government bodies so 2 that the vehicle can be used for this work. The vehicles shall not be older than the MENTIONED IN BID from the date of open 3 ing of this tender and must be in very good condition externally/internally, free fro m any history of accident. The vehicle shall have to be presented to concerned authority for inspection for ph 4 ysical condition, appearance, etc and prior approval to be taken before commence ment of the work. The vehicle should have valid insurance and pollution under control certificate. Thes 5 e certificates shall be renewed from time to time as per the existing norms of the st ate government. Railway shall not be responsible for any lapse for any of the point v iolated, which otherwise the owner of the vehicle is supposed to comply towards the governmental bodies. Copy of all papers of vehicle registration/comprehensive insurance/driving license o 6 f driver etc shall have to be submitted before commencement of service. Railway may ask presentation of original documents for authenticity. Vehicles should not be owned by Railway Officer/Staff or by their family member. 7 REQUIREMENTS FOR THE DRIVER: B The driver shall have a valid driving license for the vehicle offered. 1 The driver should not have any criminal background. The police verification certifica 2 te regarding this shall be submitted for the driver before deploying him/her to the d uties. The contractor should not change the driver frequently. In case of change of driver, 3 prior police verification certificate shall be submitted for the newer one. The driver should not be alcoholic. If the driver is found drunk on duty he shall be s 4 ent immediately back and the absent shall be marked for the day and penalty shall be imposed as per GEM SLA. The contractor shall ensure that all the drivers deployed should have live mobile ph 5 one so that they can be contacted anytime whenever required. Driver shall be educated enough to know about navigation through google map. 6
